# Cross-links and embeds

Cross-links and embeds are distinct leaves with source-faithful references.

```````````````````````````````` example
before [[cross]] and ![[embed]] after
.
Document scope=1:1..1:37 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:37 children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:7 literal="before " children=0
    ├── CrossLink scope=1:8..1:16 reference="cross" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:17..1:21 literal=" and " children=0
    ├── Embed scope=1:22..1:31 reference="embed" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:32..1:37 literal=" after" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The reference is opaque to the Markdown parser. Heading, block, and display
suffixes stay in the reference for the consumer to interpret.

```````````````````````````````` example
[[folder/note#^block|display]] ![[folder/note#^block|display]]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:62 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:62 children=3
    ├── CrossLink scope=1:1..1:30 reference="folder/note#^block|display" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:31..1:31 literal=" " children=0
    └── Embed scope=1:32..1:62 reference="folder/note#^block|display" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Empty, unclosed, and cross-line constructs remain ordinary Markdown text.

```````````````````````````````` example
![[]] [[]] [[open ![[open
[[cross
line]]
![[cross
line]]
.
Document scope=1:1..5:6 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..5:6 children=9
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:25 literal="![[]] [[]] [[open ![[open" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=0:0..0:0 children=0
    ├── Text scope=2:1..2:7 literal="[[cross" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=0:0..0:0 children=0
    ├── Text scope=3:1..3:6 literal="line]]" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=0:0..0:0 children=0
    ├── Text scope=4:1..4:8 literal="![[cross" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=0:0..0:0 children=0
    └── Text scope=5:1..5:6 literal="line]]" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Backslash-escaped openers suppress the construct. Escaped close brackets do
not terminate either form.

```````````````````````````````` example
\[[escaped]] !\[[escaped]] [[still\]] open ![[still\]] open
.
Document scope=1:1..1:59 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:59 children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:59 literal="[[escaped]] ![[escaped]] [[still]] open ![[still]] open" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The closest opener wins, and regular image and emphasis syntax keeps its
normal meaning around cross-links and embeds.

```````````````````````````````` example
[[outer[[inner]] _em_
![[outer![[inner]] ![alt](image.png)
.
Document scope=1:1..2:36 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:36 children=9
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:7 literal="[[outer" children=0
    ├── CrossLink scope=1:8..1:16 reference="inner" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:17..1:17 literal=" " children=0
    ├── Emphasis scope=1:18..1:21 children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:19..1:20 literal="em" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=0:0..0:0 children=0
    ├── Text scope=2:1..2:8 literal="![[outer" children=0
    ├── Embed scope=2:9..2:18 reference="inner" children=0
    ├── Text scope=2:19..2:19 literal=" " children=0
    └── Image scope=2:20..2:36 source="image.png" title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=2:22..2:24 literal="alt" children=0
````````````````````````````````

When syntaxes sharing `]` are nested, the most recent semantic opener owns the
close. Cross-links and embeds can therefore occur in directive labels, while a
directive inside either construct remains part of its opaque reference.

```````````````````````````````` example
:note[before [[link]] and ![[embed]] after]
[[outer :note[label]]]
![[outer :note[label]]]
.
Document scope=1:1..3:23 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..3:23 children=5
    ├── Directive scope=1:1..1:43 mode=embedded name="note" attributes=null children=1
    │   └── DirectiveLabel scope=1:6..1:43 children=5
    │       ├── Text scope=1:7..1:13 literal="before " children=0
    │       ├── CrossLink scope=1:14..1:21 reference="link" children=0
    │       ├── Text scope=1:22..1:26 literal=" and " children=0
    │       ├── Embed scope=1:27..1:36 reference="embed" children=0
    │       └── Text scope=1:37..1:42 literal=" after" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=0:0..0:0 children=0
    ├── CrossLink scope=2:1..2:22 reference="outer :note[label]" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=0:0..0:0 children=0
    └── Embed scope=3:1..3:23 reference="outer :note[label]" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Raw ASCII control bytes are source text, not internal delimiter identities.
The byte immediately after each opening `*` below is, in order, 0x01 through
0x08. Each remains in one Text run and participates normally in emphasis
flanking.

```````````````````````````````` example formula strikethrough
a* b* a* b* a* b* a* b* a* b* a* b* a* b* a* b*
.
Document scope=1:1..1:55 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:55 children=16
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:1 literal="a" children=0
    ├── Emphasis scope=1:2..1:6 children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:5 literal="\u0001 b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:7..1:8 literal=" a" children=0
    ├── Emphasis scope=1:9..1:13 children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:10..1:12 literal="\u0002 b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:14..1:15 literal=" a" children=0
    ├── Emphasis scope=1:16..1:20 children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:17..1:19 literal="\u0003 b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:21..1:22 literal=" a" children=0
    ├── Emphasis scope=1:23..1:27 children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:24..1:26 literal="\u0004 b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:28..1:29 literal=" a" children=0
    ├── Emphasis scope=1:30..1:34 children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:31..1:33 literal="\u0005 b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:35..1:36 literal=" a" children=0
    ├── Emphasis scope=1:37..1:41 children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:38..1:40 literal="\u0006 b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:42..1:43 literal=" a" children=0
    ├── Emphasis scope=1:44..1:48 children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:45..1:47 literal="\u0007 b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:49..1:50 literal=" a" children=0
    └── Emphasis scope=1:51..1:55 children=1
        └── Text scope=1:52..1:54 literal="\b b" children=0
````````````````````````````````
